question: In the Indian Constitution 'the abolition of untouchability' provision is mentioned in _______.
solution: The correct answer is__** Article 17**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Article 17:-** • Article 17 abolishes untouchability and forbids its practice in any form. • Indian Parliament passed an Untouchability (offenses) Act in 1955. • Article 17 was adopted by the constituent assembly with slogans of “Mahatma Gandhi ki Jai” • The term ‘untouchability’ is not defined in the Constitution or in the Act.
